stories.title: Flintshire’s education chief says council must put more money into schools as deficit hits £3.5m
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s education chief has told councillors the council must put more money into schools, after their combined balances fell £3.5 million into the red. stories.summary: The health board that runs NHS services in Flintshire and across North Wales does not have what it needs to deliver and sustain improvement, an independent review has concluded. stories.title: Tidal energy firm given £2m to build first turbine for Morlais site off Anglesey
stories.summary: HydroWing will use money from the North Wales Clean Energy Fund to deploy its first tidal device at Morlais in 2027.

stories.title: Deeside-based Iceland’s charity gives Christmas vouchers to almost 600 families of seriously ill children
stories.summary: Deeside-based Iceland’s charity has given £30 Christmas food vouchers to almost 600 families caring for seriously ill children, as part of a partnership built around a £250,000 fund. The Iceland Foods Charitable Foundation is working with Together for Short Lives, a charity that supports seriously ill children, their families and the UK’s 52 children’s hospices.

stories.title: How busy are Flintshire’s roads?
